purpose: Generated SupportFlow knowledge graph projection for article-first retrieval. This is runtime-safe static JSON/JSONL, not a hand-edited source of truth and not a graph database dependency.
sourceOfTruth: Article configs and generated article references
runtimePolicy: No graph database, vector database, Python stack, local embedding model, or Obsidian runtime is required by the customer plugin.
The graph improves retrieval and evidence tracing; final answers must still be grounded in selected article content and guide/action evidence.
Generated graph files must not be hand-edited.
